title: ChunkWorldBuilder
description: Patch-based world expansion plugin for Paper: builds a target world from donor-world patches as players explore.
body:
ChunkWorldBuilder is a Paper plugin that creates a dynamic exploration experience:
your target world grows patch by patch as players move toward the edge.

24x24 patch size
![24x24 patch size](https://github.com/rogualex/chunkworldbuilder/blob/main/images/patch-24x24.png?raw=1)

8x8 patch size
![8x8 patch size](https://github.com/rogualex/chunkworldbuilder/blob/main/images/patch-8x8.png?raw=1)

2x2 patch size
![2x2 patch size](https://github.com/rogualex/chunkworldbuilder/blob/main/images/patch-2x2.png?raw=1)

## Features
- Patch-based world expansion
- Donor-world terrain copying
- Configurable patch size (including tiny and large patches)
- Generation queue with per-tick limits
- Optional WorldEdit engine for faster large copies
- Edge safety (movement + teleport protection)
- Dynamic outer boundary
- End-portal progression trigger

## Requirements
- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21

## Installation
1. Download the latest jar.
2. Put it in `plugins/`.
3. Start server once.
4. Configure `plugins/ChunkWorldBuilder/config.yml`.
5. Restart server.
